RUST-04-label-slices-evidence/README.md.content:
# Packet Labels, Byte Ranges and Unicode Slices

The original course case turns `packet-42!` into `packet-42` by retaining only
ASCII letters, ASCII digits and dashes. The starter deliberately retains its
unfinished identity filter. Complete that filter before treating its label
output as correct. The reference performs the original filtering task.

The added range APIs make the module's strings, collections and bounds work
concrete. The starter returns owned copies from checked ranges. The reference
returns borrowed views. Both roles have the same range outcomes; equal printed
text does not establish that an API avoids copying its selected data.

## Index units and range contracts

`String` owns UTF-8 bytes. `&str` borrows valid UTF-8 text; `&[u8]` borrows bytes.
`Vec<char>` owns Unicode scalar values. Every range is half-open: start is
included and end is excluded. A byte offset, scalar position and displayed
grapheme are different units. The combining sequence `e\u{301}` contains two
scalars even when displayed as one accented letter. This project does not
implement grapheme segmentation.

| Function | Index unit | Starter result | Target result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sanitize` | Characters examined against the ASCII allowlist | Unfinished identity `String` | Filtered `String` |
| `str_window` | UTF-8 byte offsets | `Result<String, WindowError>` | `Result<&str, WindowError>` |
| `byte_window` | Byte offsets | `Result<Vec<u8>, WindowError>` | `Result<&[u8], WindowError>` |
| `char_window` | Unicode scalar positions | Collected `Result<String, WindowError>` | Borrowed `Result<&str, WindowError>` |

Check reversed ranges first. Next reject an end beyond the relevant length.
String byte ranges must also start and end on UTF-8 character boundaries.
`a🦀bc` has seven bytes and four scalars: its crab occupies bytes `1..5`.
The byte range `2..3` is a valid one-byte byte slice, but cannot form `&str`.
The scalar range `1..2` selects the complete crab. An empty string range is
valid only at a character boundary; byte and scalar empty ranges use their
own lengths. Preserve `Reversed`, `OutOfBounds` and `NotCharBoundary` rather
than converting every failure into an empty successful slice.

## Build and observe

Use Rust 1.97.1 with Cargo, rustfmt and Clippy. The crates use edition 2024 and
no third-party packages. From the selected role directory:

```sh
rustc -Vv
cargo -V
cargo fmt --all --check
rustfmt --edition 2024 --check diagnostics/*.rs
cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline -- --sanitize 'packet-42!'
cargo run --locked --offline -- --window 'a🦀bc' 1 5
cargo run --locked --offline -- --bytes 'a🦀bc' 2 3
cargo run --locked --offline -- --chars 'a🦀bc' 1 2
cargo run --locked --offline -- --window 'a🦀bc' 2 3
cargo clean
cargo test --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline
```

The unfinished starter default is `label=packet-42!`; the completed target is
`label=packet-42`. Both range examples print `window=🦀 bytes=4 scalars=1`, and
the byte example prints `bytes=[159]`. The non-boundary string range has empty
stdout, status 65 and stderr `error=not-character-boundary`. Reversed and
out-of-bounds errors use their own codes. Invalid command shapes, index syntax
or non-UTF-8 arguments use status 64. Successful results use status 0. The
library returns values; only the CLI selects an exit status.

## Core: complete the existing label filter

Complete CORE, LABEL CASES, PREDICT, CHECKS and LIMITS in `observations.md`.
Implement the original ASCII allowlist. Preserve allowed text and empty input;
reject punctuation, underscores, whitespace, controls and non-ASCII letters by
removing them. Replace the deliberately named identity-baseline test with new
filter assertions. Check a custom mixed Unicode case and all ASCII values.
Allowed-character filtering does not establish context-specific HTML, SQL or
shell escaping, nor an application-wide size or resource policy.

## Required continuation: checked borrowed ranges

Continue the same saved project and complete WINDOWS. Refactor `str_window`
and `byte_window` to return views tied to their input. Preserve error priority,
zero-length behavior and every range outcome. Add a new multibyte fixture and
an explicit source-offset diagram. Explain why bytes inside a scalar can form
`&[u8]` while the same interval cannot form `&str`. Adapt return-type-shaped
tests while preserving the behavioral checks.

## Choice: map scalar positions to byte boundaries

Complete CHOICE. Replace the temporary `Vec<char>` in `char_window` with a
borrowed result using `char_indices`. Handle the end-of-string boundary and
empty ranges. Add a combining-mark fixture and explain why scalar slicing
still does not implement grapheme slicing. Compare the borrowed result's
source range with the owned baseline rather than inferring timing results.

## Challenge: distinguish compilation, panic and returned error

Complete CHALLENGE. Compile the standalone files separately from Cargo tests.
`string-index.rs` intentionally fails with E0277. The three direct range/index
examples compile but panic with status 101. Each paired checked example runs
successfully and reports `Some` or `None` instead. Predict each result first.

```sh
mkdir -p evidence
rustc --edition=2024 --emit=metadata diagnostics/string-index.rs -o evidence/index.rmeta
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/byte-out-of-bounds.rs -o evidence/bytes
./evidence/bytes
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/non-boundary-slice.rs -o evidence/text
./evidence/text
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/reversed-range.rs -o evidence/range
./evidence/range
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/scalar-index.rs -o evidence/scalar
./evidence/scalar
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/checked-byte.rs -o evidence/checked-byte
./evidence/checked-byte
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/checked-string.rs -o evidence/checked-string
./evidence/checked-string
rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/checked-range.rs -o evidence/checked-range
./evidence/checked-range
```

A safe Rust bounds panic stops this process; it is not an out-of-bounds memory
read. A compile refusal has no runtime output. The project library's checked
functions return errors rather than reproducing those diagnostic panics.
Retain source, worksheet, exact commands, tool versions and actual stdout,
stderr and status together. Compare the reference after the independent attempt.

References: [Rust strings](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch08-02-strings.html),
[`str::get`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/primitive.str.html#method.get),
[`slice::get`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/primitive.slice.html#method.get).

RUST-04-label-slices-evidence/solution/o.content:
# Label and slice observations

## CORE
The target keeps ASCII alphanumeric characters and dashes; the identity baseline is unfinished.

## LABEL CASES
packet-42! becomes packet-42. Non-ASCII letters, underscores, punctuation and controls are removed. Allowed empty output remains a valid String.

## PREDICT
a🦀bc has seven bytes and four scalars. Bytes1..5 and scalars1..2 select the crab; bytes2..3 is [159], but that interval is not valid str.

## CHECKS
The eight tests cover exact ASCII membership, default task distinction, valid windows, ordered errors, scalar/grapheme distinction, small-range enumeration and usize extremes. Actual command observations must be recorded separately.

## WINDOWS
The target returns &str and &[u8] tied to the input. get validates the selected range; an empty byte interval inside a multibyte scalar is still not a str boundary.

## CHOICE
char_indices maps scalar positions to byte boundaries. Chaining the final byte length permits the end position. Combining marks remain separate scalars; no grapheme segmentation is claimed.

## CHALLENGE
String indexing by usize fails E0277. Direct invalid byte, UTF-8 and reversed ranges compile and panic101. Checked examples return None; scalar nth returns Some('🦀'). These are distinct outcomes.

## LIMITS
The code uses safe Rust and bounded teaching fixtures. Filtering is not context-sensitive escaping; no timing or application-wide resource guarantee follows from these examples.

.github/workflows/rust-label-slices.yml.content:
name: Rust label-slices evidence

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "RUST-04-label-slices-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_label_slices.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-label-slices.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "RUST-04-label-slices-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_label_slices.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-label-slices.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: "1.97.1"
      SOURCE_REVISION: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the recorded course toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.97.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Verify label filtering, range units and deliberate diagnostic failures
        run: python3 test/verify_rust_label_slices.py --proof output/rust-label-slices/proof.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        if: always()
        with:
          name: rust-label-slices-evidence
          path: output/rust-label-slices/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

test/verify_rust_label_slices.py.content:
"""Validate the complete RSS4 label and range roles and intentional compiler refusals."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import tomllib

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACK=ROOT/'RUST-04-label-slices-evidence'
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--proof',type=Path,required=True)
args=parser.parse_args();args.proof=args.proof.resolve()
assert not args.proof.exists()
assert os.getuid()!=0 and os.uname().sysname=='Linux' and os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
OUT=args.proof.parent;OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
commands=[]

def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def stop(signum,_frame):raise SystemExit(128+signum)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop);signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)

def run(command,cwd,label,expected=0,env=None):
    entry=dict(parentTaskId='rust-label-slices-evidence',parentPid=os.getpid(),command=[os.fsdecode(value) for value in command],cwd=str(cwd),
               startTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),timeoutSeconds=120)
    child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
    entry['pid']=child.pid
    with (OUT/'processes.jsonl').open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry,event='start'))+'\n')
    stdout,stderr=b'',b'';cleanup='owned process exited'
    try:stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=120)
    except BaseException:
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            try:stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);stdout,stderr=child.communicate()
        cleanup='owned process group terminated and reaped';raise
    finally:
        with (OUT/'processes.jsonl').open('a') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry,event='end',endTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),exitCode=child.returncode,childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup))+'\n')
        (OUT/(label+'.stdout.txt')).write_bytes(stdout);(OUT/(label+'.stderr.txt')).write_bytes(stderr)
    assert child.returncode==expected,(label,child.returncode,stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
    commands.append(dict(label=label,exitCode=child.returncode,stdoutSha256=sha(stdout),stderrSha256=sha(stderr)))
    return stdout,stderr


source_names=run(['git','ls-files','--','RUST-04-label-slices-evidence','.github/workflows/rust-label-slices.yml','test/verify_rust_label_slices.py'],ROOT,'source-inventory')[0].decode().splitlines()
assert len(source_names)==len(set(source_names))==30
source={name:(ROOT/name).read_bytes() for name in source_names}
for name,raw in source.items():
    target=OUT/'source'/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(raw)
versions={}
for name,command in [('rustc',['rustc','-Vv']),('cargo',['cargo','-V']),('rustfmt',['rustfmt','--version']),('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--version'])]:
    versions[name]=run(command,ROOT,'version-'+name)[0].decode()
assert 'release: 1.97.1\n' in versions['rustc']
texts=['','packet-42!','a🦀bc','é','e\u0301','é🦀A','--FLAG','  A_B!','A\tB\nC','中-A-9','ßé🦀','0123456789','A-Z-a-z','\x7f']
texts=[t.replace('\u0301','\u0301').replace('\t','\t').replace('\n','\n').replace('\x7f','\x7f') for t in texts]
def predict(role,mode,text,start=None,end=None):
    if mode=='sanitize':
        clean=text if role=='starter' else ''.join(ch for ch in text if ch in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-')
        return ('label='+clean+'\n').encode(),b'',0
    raw=text.encode();length=len(text) if mode=='chars' else len(raw)
    if start>end:code='range-reversed'
    elif end>length:code='out-of-bounds'
    elif mode=='bytes':return ('bytes='+str(list(raw[start:end]))+'\n').encode(),b'',0
    else:
        try:selected=text[start:end] if mode=='chars' else raw[start:end].decode()
        except UnicodeDecodeError:code='not-character-boundary'
        else:
            # An empty byte interval must still lie on a scalar boundary.
            boundaries={0};offset=0
            for character in text:offset+=len(character.encode());boundaries.add(offset)
            if mode=='window' and (start not in boundaries or end not in boundaries):code='not-character-boundary'
            else:return f'window={selected} bytes={len(selected.encode())} scalars={len(selected)}\n'.encode(),b'',0
    return b'',('error='+code+'\n').encode(),65
roles=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rust-label-slices-evidence-') as temporary:
    work=Path(temporary)
    for role in ['starter','solution']:
        selected=PACK/role;directory=work/role;shutil.copytree(selected,directory)
        role_out=OUT/role;role_out.mkdir()
        env={**os.environ,'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(work/(role+'-target')),'CARGO_TERM_COLOR':'never','RUST_BACKTRACE':'0'}
        lock=(directory/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()
        manifest=tomllib.loads((directory/'Cargo.toml').read_text());assert manifest['package']['edition']=='2024' and 'dependencies' not in manifest
        assert tomllib.loads(lock.decode())['package']==[{'name':'label_slice_lab','version':'0.1.0'}]
        run(['cargo','fmt','--all','--check'],directory,role+'-format',env=env)
        diagnostics=sorted(str(p.relative_to(directory)) for p in (directory/'diagnostics').glob('*.rs'));assert len(diagnostics)==8
        run(['rustfmt','--edition','2024','--check',*diagnostics],directory,role+'-diagnostic-format',env=env)
        run(['cargo','clippy','--locked','--offline','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings'],directory,role+'-clippy',env=env)
        assert b'8 passed; 0 failed' in run(['cargo','test','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-tests',env=env)[0]
        run(['cargo','build','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-build',env=env)
        binary=Path(env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'])/'debug/label_slice_lab'
        default=run([str(binary)],directory,role+'-default',env=env);assert default==predict(role,'sanitize','packet-42!')[:2]
        cases=[]
        for text in texts:
            cases.append(('sanitize',text,None,None))
        for text in texts[:6]:
            for mode in ['window','bytes','chars']:
                size=len(text) if mode=='chars' else len(text.encode())
                pairs={(0,0),(0,size),(size,size),(size+1,size+1),(1,0),(0,size+1),(1,2),(2,3)}
                cases.extend((mode,text,start,end) for start,end in sorted(pairs))
        for index,(mode,text,start,end) in enumerate(cases):
            argv=['--sanitize',text] if mode=='sanitize' else ['--'+mode,text,str(start),str(end)]
            expected=predict(role,mode,text,start,end)
            assert run([str(binary),*argv],directory,f'{role}-input-{index}',expected=expected[2],env=env)==expected[:2]
        usage=b'usage: label_slice_lab [--sanitize text | --window text start end | --bytes text start end | --chars text start end]\n'
        for index,argv in enumerate([['--other'],['--sanitize'],['--window','a','0'],['--bytes','a','0','1','extra']]):
            assert run([str(binary),*argv],directory,f'{role}-usage-{index}',expected=64,env=env)==(b'',usage)
        for index,value in enumerate(['','-1','+1',' 1','١','1.0','18446744073709551616']):
            assert run([str(binary),'--window','a',value,'1'],directory,f'{role}-bad-index-{index}',expected=64,env=env)==(b'',b'indices must be ASCII decimal usize values\n')
        assert run([os.fsencode(binary),b'--sanitize',b'\xff'],directory,role+'-invalid-utf8',expected=64,env=env)==(b'',b'arguments must be valid UTF-8\n')
        target=role_out/'string-index.rmeta'
        stdout,stderr=run(['rustc','--edition=2024','--emit=metadata','diagnostics/string-index.rs','-o',str(target)],directory,role+'-string-index',expected=1,env=env)
        assert not stdout and b'E0277' in stderr and not target.exists()
        hashes={}
        for name in ['byte-out-of-bounds','non-boundary-slice','reversed-range','scalar-index','checked-byte','checked-string','checked-range']:
            target=role_out/name
            run(['rustc','--edition=2024','diagnostics/'+name+'.rs','-o',str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name+'-build',env=env)
            refused=name in ['byte-out-of-bounds','non-boundary-slice','reversed-range']
            out,err=run([str(target)],directory,role+'-'+name+'-run',expected=101 if refused else 0,env=env)
            if refused:assert not out and b'panicked' in err
            else:assert not err and out==("Some('🦀')\n".encode() if name=='scalar-index' else b'None\n')
            hashes[name]=sha(target.read_bytes())
        run(['cargo','clean'],directory,role+'-clean',env=env);assert not binary.exists()
        assert b'8 passed; 0 failed' in run(['cargo','test','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-clean-tests',env=env)[0]
        run(['cargo','build','--locked','--offline'],directory,role+'-clean-build',env=env)
        assert run([str(binary)],directory,role+'-clean-default',env=env)==default
        assert (directory/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()==lock
        assert all(p.read_bytes()==(selected/p.relative_to(directory)).read_bytes() for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
        shutil.copyfile(binary,role_out/'label_slice_lab')
        roles.append(dict(role=role,inputCases=len(cases),unitTests=8,unitTestsBeforeAndAfterClean=True,sourceAndLockUnchanged=True,unfinishedIdentityOrCompletedFilter='unfinished identity' if role=='starter' else 'completed ASCII filter',fixedAndPanicExecutableSha256=hashes,executableSha256=sha(binary.read_bytes())))
assert not work.exists() and all((ROOT/name).read_bytes()==raw for name,raw in source.items())
proof=dict(sourceRevision=os.environ.get('SOURCE_REVISION'),sourceFiles={n:sha(r) for n,r in source.items()},compilerVersions=versions,commands=commands,roles=roles,nativeExecuted=True,ordinaryUser=True,allSourceFilesUnchanged=True,temporarySourceCleanup=True,externalDependencyDownloadsDuringChecks=False,worksheetCompletionNotInferred=True,graphemeSegmentationNotClaimed=True)
args.proof.write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(sourceFiles=30,commands=len(commands),inputCases=sum(r['inputCases'] for r in roles),compilerRefusals=2,intentionalPanics=6,temporarySourceCleanup=True)))
